Room.title: Room
Room.description: An independent Secret Santa event room where participants self-register via invite code or link.

code.description: Unique uppercase alphanumeric room invitation code.

title.description: Display title of the gift exchange room.

currency.description: Currency symbol or code for the gift budget.

exchangeDate.description: Optional exchange date in YYYY-MM-DD format or empty string.

organizerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the organizer who created the room.

organizerName.description: Display name of the room organizer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated.

RoomParticipant.title: RoomParticipant
RoomParticipant.description: Self-registered participant profile inside a Secret Santa room.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the participant.

organizerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent room organizer.

message.description: Personal note or hint for the Secret Santa.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

RoomAssignment.title: RoomAssignment
RoomAssignment.description: Private Secret Santa assignment readable only by the assigned giver.

giverUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the participant giving the gift.

organizerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room organizer.

recipientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the assigned recipient.

recipientName.description: Display name of the assigned recipient.

recipientLikes.description: Wishlist and gift ideas submitted by the recipient.

recipientRestrictions.description: Gift restrictions or allergies submitted by the recipient.

recipientMessage.description: Personal message submitted by the recipient.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the draw assignment was created.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Shared Secret Santa event rooms identified by invite code.

/rooms/{roomId}/participants/{participan.description: Independent self-registered participants linked to a room.

/rooms/{roomId}/assignments/{giverUid}.description: Private Secret Santa assignment records readable solely by giverUid.
